Metadata.title: CV Simple | Create a one-page resume
Metadata.description: Create and download a professional one-page resume in PDF and DOCX for free, without registration or uploading personal data to a server.
Metadata.imageAlt: CV Simple, a free and private one-page resume builder

App.myCvsDescription: Save different versions of your resume in this browser, such as one in English and another in Spanish.
App.cvNameHelp: Use a name to distinguish versions in the same language or different templates. If left empty, one will be generated automatically.
App.cvSaveError: The resume could not be saved in this browser.
App.noSavedCvs: You have not saved any resumes yet
App.noSavedCvsHelp: Resumes you save will appear here and remain only in this browser.
App.libraryLoadError: Saved resumes could not be loaded.
App.heroTitle: Create a resume that gets to the point.
App.heroDescription: Design a professional one-page resume, customize it, and download it as PDF or DOCX. No account, no surprise paywall, and no uploading your personal data.
App.howTitle: From a blank page to a resume ready to send
App.howDescription: You do not need to learn a design tool or discover a paywall when you finish.
App.step1Description: Include only the sections you need. The limits are designed to keep your resume clear and on one page.
App.step2Description: Choose a template, colors, typography, photo shape, and reorder content by dragging each item.
App.step3Description: Export directly to PDF or DOCX. No registration or paid download unlock is required.
App.benefitsTitle: What a free resume builder should provide
App.benefitFreeDescription: There are no premium features, hidden limits, or payment screen at the end.
App.benefitPrivateDescription: Your resume content and photograph are processed in your browser, not on our servers.
App.benefitFlexibleDescription: Customize sections, headings, lists, and styles while keeping different versions locally.
App.benefitOnePageDescription: Content limits and the space indicator help keep your information relevant and readable.
App.landingTemplatesTitle: Choose a template without losing your content
App.landingTemplatesDescription: Changing the design does not remove your information. Select a template to apply it and return to the editor.
App.privacyTitle: Your resume should not feed a database
App.privacyDescription: CV Simple works without accounts and processes the document on your device. Saving is optional and remains in your browser storage.
App.privacyPointThree: Delete local data whenever you want
App.faq1Answer: Yes. Every template, customization option, and export format is available without payments or premium features.
App.faq2Question: Do I need to create an account?
App.faq2Answer: No. You can create and download your resume without registering. My resumes uses browser-local storage only.
App.faq3Answer: The form is processed on your device. If you enable autosave or save a resume, the information remains in that browser's storage.
App.faq4Question: Can I download the resume as Word and PDF?
App.faq4Answer: Yes. You can export it as PDF or DOCX. If you later edit the DOCX, the page also provides a link to an external conversion service.
App.faq5Question: What happens if I clear my browser data?
App.faq5Answer: Locally saved drafts and resumes may be removed. Backup and import options without accounts are planned for a future update.
App.finalCtaTitle: Your next resume can start now
App.finalCtaDescription: No registration, no payment at the end, and full control over your data.
App.footerDescription: A free, private, and open-source resume builder.
App.footerLicense: Source code available under AGPL-3.0. The CV Simple brand is reserved.
App.confirmRestoreHelp: All information currently shown in the editor will be replaced. If autosave is enabled, the draft or open resume will also be updated.
App.name: Name
App.photoHelp: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Processed locally.
App.colorsHelp: Customize the palette without changing the resume structure or layout.
App.sectionOrderHelp: Drag sections to reorder them in the preview, PDF, and DOCX. Contact and Languages remain in the sidebar.
App.noSectionsToOrder: Add content to a section to change its position.
App.sectionCustomizationHelp: Customize existing titles or add up to 3 sections of your own. Leave a title blank to keep its default value.
App.achievements: Achievements and responsibilities · up to 4 bullets
App.privacyNotice: We don't use accounts, databases, or personal data storage. Closing or refreshing this tab will discard your changes.
App.autoSaveOnHelp: Your changes are stored only on this device. Turning it off deletes the automatic draft but keeps resumes saved in My resumes.
App.autoSaveOffHelp: It is disabled. Save the resume to My resumes before closing the tab if you want to keep it.
App.autoSaveDisabled: Autosave disabled and draft deleted. Your saved resumes were kept.
App.autoSaveError: This browser does not have enough space to store the resume. Autosave was disabled.
App.localPrivacyReminder: Your data and photo are processed on this device and are not sent to our servers.
App.downloadPrivacy: It is generated in your browser; your data is never sent to a server.
App.editedDocx: Did you edit the DOCX after downloading it?
App.editedDocxHelp: If you made changes in Word, you can convert that modified version back to PDF.
